subject: Access blocked after SSO->Zip migration: tenant mapping mismatch
messages:
From: AeroCraft Supply <onboarding@aerocraft.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Access blocked after SSO->Zip migration: tenant mapping mismatch

Hi Karthik,

We're trying to complete the vendor setup for AeroCraft but hitting a hard stop when the supplier clicks the invite link. The portal shows "No account found for your organisation" and then redirects to an error page. Attached a screenshot and a SAML trace from our IdP.

Steps we took:
- Received invite from Redwood (via Zip).
- Click invite, redirected to our corporate IdP (Okta).
- Authenticate successfully, then Zip returns an error about tenant claim.

We haven't changed our domain or IdP recently. Can you check whether the tenant claim is being translated correctly after the migration to Zip? This is blocking our first PO acceptance.

Attaching: login-error-screenshot.png, saml-trace.txt

Thanks,
Rajiv Menon
Onboarding Lead, AeroCraft Supply
rajiv@aerocraft.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: AeroCraft Supply <onboarding@aerocraft.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Access blocked after SSO->Zip migration: tenant mapping mismatch

Ben/Marissa — looping you in. External report indicates SAML NameID / tenant claim not mapping after our Zip migration for supplier invites. Rajiv attached the IdP trace and a screenshot.

Quick asks:
- Ben, can you pull the Zip logs for relay/ACS at ~09:10 PT and check whether the tenant claim (org_name / org_id) is present or being dropped?
- Marissa, can you confirm the invite record (HS-12345) tenant binding on the invite and whether we sent the old tenant alias or the new one?

Rajiv — apologize for the disruption. We'll try the quick workaround (create a temporary local mapping) if we can confirm the NameID mismatch. Will update within 30 mins.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: AeroCraft Supply <onboarding@aerocraft.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T10:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Access blocked after SSO->Zip migration: tenant mapping mismatch

On 18 Jun 2028 09:34, Karthik Iyer wrote:
> Ben/Marissa — looping you in. External report indicates SAML NameID / tenant claim not mapping after our Zip migration for supplier invites.

Checked the Zip service logs: incoming SAML assertion arrives but the attribute named "tenant_alias" is empty for the AeroCraft assertion. Their NameID is present (email), but our relay rule that maps old alias -> tenant_id wasn't applied because the assertion included the new attribute name "org_claim" (we renamed attributes during migration).

Short-term fix: I can create a temporary mapping that accepts either "tenant_alias" or "org_claim" for the next 48 hours for invite flow HS-12345. That will let Rajiv sign in and accept the PO.

Long-term: We need a migration pass that updates stored invite records to the new claim name or keep an aliasing layer in Zip. I'll file SUP-783 to schedule the migration.

Ben Carter
Customer Ops — Onboarding
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@aerocraft.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Access blocked after SSO->Zip migration: tenant mapping mismatch

Karthik / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround. I clicked the invite again after Ben's temporary mapping was applied and the portal let me in. I was able to accept the PO and upload W9.

Appreciate the help. Please keep me posted when the migration pass (SUP-783) is scheduled so we know if there are any further re-invite steps.

Cheers,
Rajiv
